q: 今天很冷，每___学生都穿着厚外套。
en: It is cold today and every student is wearing a thick coat.

q: 我昨天买了一___厚大衣，下雪的时候穿。
en: I bought a thick overcoat yesterday to wear when it snows.

q: 医生让我吃这___种药，别的先别吃。
en: The doctor told me to take these two kinds of medicine and leave the others for now.

q: 春天到了，院子里有两___桃树开花了。
en: Spring has come and two peach trees in the yard are in blossom.

q: 医生一再提醒，这三___药不能和酒一起吃，不然会很危险。
en: The doctor warned again that these three kinds of medicine must not be taken with alcohol.

q: 外面下雨了，你带一___伞吧。
en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.

q: 我发烧了，妈妈拿来一___退烧药让我吃。
en: I had a fever, so mum brought me a tablet of fever medicine to take.

q: 秋天到了，地上落了一___黄叶。
en: Autumn has come and a yellow leaf has fallen on the ground.

q: 护士拿来一___体温计，让我量一量体温。
en: The nurse brought a thermometer and asked me to take my temperature.

q: 他一直在咳嗽，我给他递了一___纸巾。
en: He kept coughing, so I handed him a tissue.

q: 听说明天有大雪，奶奶特意在我的包里放了一___又厚又长的围巾。
en: I heard it will snow heavily tomorrow, so Grandma put a thick, long scarf in my bag.

q: 暴雨过后，小路上倒了一___大树，车都过不去。
en: After the storm a big tree had fallen across the small road and no cars could get past.

q: 夏天太热了，我家新买了一___空调。
en: It is so hot in summer that we bought a new air conditioner.

q: 雪地里有一___小鸟在找东西吃。
en: There is a little bird in the snow looking for something to eat.

q: 下大雨了，路上的车很少，只有一___公共汽车慢慢开过来。
en: It was pouring and there were few cars; only one bus came slowly along.

q: 台风快来了，农场里的那两___牛都被带进了棚里。
en: A typhoon was coming, so the two cows on the farm were brought into the shed.

q: 医院新买了一___大机器，可以给病人检查身体。
en: The hospital bought a big new machine that can examine patients.

q: 农场的人说，下暴雨以前，那几___猪一直不肯吃东西。
en: The farmer said that before the downpour those few pigs refused to eat.

q: 这___药店离我家很近，我感冒的时候常去。
en: This pharmacy is close to my home and I often go there when I have a cold.

q: 我们住的酒店在二十___，窗外可以看到下雪。
en: Our hotel room is on the twentieth floor and you can see snow outside the window.

q: 我们家有四___人，冬天常常一起吃火锅。
en: There are four people in my family and in winter we often have hot pot together.

q: 下大雨以后，那___桥被水冲坏了，我们只好走另一条路。
en: After the heavy rain that bridge was washed out so we had to take another road.

q: 医院的这___病房很安静，朝南，下午有阳光。
en: This hospital ward is quiet, faces south and gets sun in the afternoon.

q: 那___山冬天常常下雪，山顶上一年四季都是白的。
en: That mountain often has snow in winter and its top is white all year round.

q: 我家住在六___，没有电梯，生病的时候上楼很难。
en: We live on the sixth floor with no lift, so it is hard to climb the stairs when I am ill.

q: 这座城市夏天又热又潮，所以市中心新开了好几___卖空调和风扇的商店。
en: The summers in this city are hot and damp, so several shops selling air conditioners and fans have opened downtown.

q: 夏天的时候，我们一家四___人经常开车去海边度假。
en: In summer the four of us often drive to the seaside for a holiday.

q: 感冒了，多喝几___热水就会好一点儿。
en: If you have a cold, drink a few cups of hot water and you'll feel better.

q: 天太热了，我一口气喝了两___冰水。
en: It was so hot that I drank two bottles of iced water in one go.

q: 我生病的时候，妈妈给我煮了一___热粥。
en: When I was ill, Mum cooked me a bowl of hot porridge.

q: 冬天路滑，爸爸给我买了一___防滑的鞋。
en: The roads are slippery in winter, so Dad bought me a pair of non-slip shoes.

q: 医生说我可以吃东西了，我点了一___清淡的午饭。
en: The doctor said I could eat again, so I ordered a light lunch.

q: 天冷了，奶奶给我织了一___厚手套。
en: It has got cold, so Grandma knitted me a pair of thick gloves.

q: 夏天容易出汗，我每天都要多喝几___水。
en: I sweat easily in summer, so I have to drink a few more cups of water every day.

q: 医生建议我换一___更安静的房子，这样晚上才能睡好。
en: The doctor advised me to move to a quieter flat so that I can sleep well at night.

q: 夏天太热，他一连吃了三___西瓜，结果肚子疼了。
en: It was so hot that he ate three pieces of watermelon in a row and ended up with a stomach ache.

q: 她因为身体不好，辞掉了原来那___工作。
en: Because of her poor health she gave up her former job.

q: 昨天下了一___大雪，路上到处都是白的。
en: It snowed heavily yesterday and the roads are white everywhere.

q: 我今天上午有两___课，下午去医院。
en: I have two classes this morning and go to the hospital in the afternoon.

q: 我感冒好了，今天想吃一___好吃的。
en: My cold has gone and today I want to have a nice meal.

q: 这个学期我选了一___关于健康的课，老师是位医生。
en: This term I chose a course on health, and the teacher is a doctor.

q: 下午第二___是体育课，下雨的话就在室内上。
en: The second period this afternoon is PE, and if it rains it will be held indoors.

q: 夏天的晚上，公园里有一___露天音乐会，很多人去听。
en: On summer evenings there is an open-air concert in the park and many people go.

q: 她唱了一___关于春天的歌，大家都鼓掌了。
en: She sang a song about spring and everyone applauded.

q: 这___感冒在冬天特别常见，不一定要吃药。
en: This kind of cold is very common in winter and doesn't always need medicine.

q: 因为下大雨，那___足球比赛被取消了。
en: Because of the heavy rain, that football match was cancelled.

q: 一___春雨过后，山上的树都变绿了。
en: After one spring rain the trees on the hills all turned green.

q: 为了不感冒，你应该好好吃每一___饭，不要饿着肚子去上班。
en: To avoid catching a cold, you should eat every meal properly and not go to work hungry.

q: 医生让我每天吃三___药，饭后吃。
en: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day after meals.

q: 我昨天去了一___医院，医生说我没事。
en: I went to the hospital yesterday and the doctor said I was fine.

q: 医生说这个药很难吃，你把说明书从头到尾读一___再吃。
en: The doctor said the medicine is hard to take, so read the instructions from beginning to end once before you take it.

q: 她感冒好了以后，又去了两___医院复查。
en: After her cold got better she went to the hospital twice more for a check-up.

q: 护士让我再量一___体温，因为刚才的数字不太准。
en: The nurse asked me to take my temperature once more because the earlier reading was not accurate.

q: 今年夏天我感冒了两___，每次都发烧。
en: I caught a cold twice this summer and had a fever each time.

q: 这首关于春天的歌，我从头到尾听了三___，还是没听懂。
en: I listened to this song about spring three times all the way through and still did not understand it.

q: 奶奶住院的时候，爸爸每个星期都要跑好几___医院，一天也没休息过。
en: When Grandma was in hospital Dad had to make several trips to the hospital every week without a day off.

q: 这___药都是医生给我的，一天吃三次。
en: These medicines were all given to me by the doctor and I take them three times a day.

q: 我买了一些___水果，想送给生病的同学。
en: I bought some fruit to give to my classmate who is ill.

q: 我只喝了一点儿___水，还是很渴。
en: I only drank a little water and I was still thirsty.

q: 那___不爱穿厚衣服的同学，最近都感冒了。
en: Those classmates who don't like wearing thick clothes have all caught colds recently.

q: 夏天来了，商店里新到了一些___西瓜，又大又便宜。
en: Summer is here and some new watermelons have arrived in the shop, big and cheap.

q: 下了几天雨，衣服都潮了，这___衣服都得拿出去晒。
en: After several days of rain the clothes are damp, and all these clothes have to be put out in the sun.

q: 医生说我的病不严重，只要多休息，再吃一点儿___药就能好。
en: The doctor said my illness is not serious: with more rest and a little more medicine I'll recover.

q: 我每___早上都跑步，身体越来越好。
en: I run every morning and I am getting healthier.

q: 我感冒了，在家休息了两___。
en: I had a cold and rested at home for two days.

q: 他生病了，在医院住了三___月。
en: He was ill and stayed in hospital for three months.

q: 医生让我休息两___星期，不能去上班。
en: The doctor told me to rest for two weeks and not go to work.

q: 他每天睡八___小时，所以身体很好。
en: He sleeps eight hours a day, so he is in good health.

q: 这个夏天特别热，已经三___月没下雨了。
en: This summer has been very hot and it has not rained for three months.

q: 我们这里的冬天很长，一年有四___月都在下雪。
en: Winters are long here and it snows for four months of the year.

q: 我在南方住了五___，已经习惯了这里又湿又热的夏天。
en: I lived in the south for five years and have got used to the hot, damp summers there.

q: 医生说，每___星期至少要运动三次，每次三十分钟。
en: The doctor said you should exercise at least three times every week, thirty minutes each time.

q: 这几___夏天越来越热，大家都买了空调。
en: Summers have been getting hotter in recent years and everyone has bought an air conditioner.

q: 他一直发烧，在家躺了半___月才好。
en: He kept running a fever and lay at home for half a month before he got better.
